A CLEAR VIEW OF THE PREVIEW

Built for the bench.
Growing deliberately.

TraceX is a native Rust desktop application using egui. This website introduces the desktop product; it does not connect to your serial port.

IN THE CURRENT BUILD

Serial connection settings · live log view · text search and severity filtering · command send/history · text auto-save and export

STILL BEING QUALIFIED

Real-device compatibility, long-session responsiveness and crash recovery. Monitor views currently share capture; independent concurrent device sessions are not promised.

DIRECTION, NOT DELIVERY DATES

Independent device sessions, stronger persistence and additional transports. Cloud collaboration and AI diagnostics are future ideas.

BEFORE YOU CONNECT

A few useful details.

Who is this preview for?

Engineers who want to evaluate a developing serial workspace and share specific feedback. It is not production qualified. Keep a separate trusted capture for critical investigations.

Which operating systems are available?

This preview targets Windows x86_64 and has been built and checked on Windows 11. Extract the ZIP, then run tracex.exe. If Windows reports a missing VCRUNTIME140.dll, see Microsoft’s Visual C++ v14 x64 runtime instructions (version 14.44 or later). The runtime is not bundled. Broader OS and physical-device qualification remain open.

Where do my logs go?

The desktop workflow uses local auto-save and export files. This page has no upload form, account system or analytics script. Hosting providers may process ordinary request information. If you report a public GitHub issue, only attach logs you are comfortable publishing.

Is the preview free?

Yes. This version permits free personal and internal business use under the preview binary license. No account, subscription or payment is required. This does not promise that every future feature will be free. Third-party licenses and relevant sources are included in the ZIP.

How can I give feedback?

Use the TraceX GitHub issues page. Include the version, Windows version, device/adapter, steps and expected result. Remove credentials and sensitive device data. GitHub sign-in may be required to submit.

Does Auto-Save guarantee recovery?

No. Text auto-save exists in the current build; crash recovery, disk-failure handling and durability guarantees need further qualification. The development preview should not be your sole copy of important evidence.
